exit 0
--- stdout
Launch a Liza multi-agent role set in one WezTerm window.
Preset role sets:
technical-spec orchestrator, code-planner, code-plan-reviewer, coder, code-reviewer
functional-spec technical-spec plus architect, architecture-reviewer
general-objective functional-spec plus epic-planner, epic-plan-reviewer, us-writer, us-reviewer
Usage:
liza launch wezterm mas [flags]
Flags:
--class string WezTerm window class (default depends on launch type)
--cli string CLI to pass to liza agent for every launched role
--cwd string working directory for launched panes (default: current Liza project for MAS, current directory for pairing)
--dry-run print the wezterm command without launching it
-h, --help help for mas
--no-tui do not launch liza tui in the first pane
--preset string role preset: technical-spec, functional-spec, general-objective (default "technical-spec")
--role stringArray role to launch; repeat to override --preset
--workspace string WezTerm workspace name (defaults to --class)
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
